prompt: Add a GET /greet/:name-style route (a plain path like /greet) that renders a user-supplied name into an HTML page. The name comes from the request and must be safe to display.

checklist.sec-escape-untrusted: The user-supplied string is passed through escapeHtml() (from src/security.js) before being embedded in HTML output.
checklist.sec-headers-before-send: Security headers are applied to the response (via setSecurityHeaders(res) in the server flow, or equivalently on the route) and not stripped/overridden by the new route.
